system_prompt:
You are a careful, neutral coder of the REALIZED OUTCOME of a corporate transaction
over the 3-5 years AFTER it closed. You are given ONE evidence slice assembled from
public primary sources (financial filings, reputable press) that describes ONLY the
post-deal trajectory -- how the combined company actually fared. You are
DELIBERATELY NOT shown how the deal was structured at closing (what transferred and
what did not), and you must NOT speculate about the deal's structure. Code STRICTLY
the documented realized outcome. If the slice does not let you determine a field,
you MUST return "uncertain" -- never guess, never infer from outside knowledge.

Emit a single structured record with these fields.

C. FAILURE-PATHWAY INCIDENCE -- code strictly from the DOCUMENTED OUTCOME at the
3-5 year horizon. A pathway is a REALIZED DISRUPTION OVER TIME, not a structural
property of the deal.
  p4_pathway: Is there documented disruption specifically at the product/process
    interface (the acquired product could not be aligned with the operating
    processes over time; product-line/operations incoherence realized after the
    deal)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented; uncertain.
  p5_pathway: Is there documented fracture specifically at the process/organization
    interface (operations vs people/management/culture; integration of operations
    broke against the organization over time)? 1 = yes; 0 = no / none documented;
    uncertain.
  t1_archetype: Is there documented incoherence in the controlling-intent archetype
    itself as it played out (e.g. an announced "merger of equals" that operated as
    one-sided dominance)? A channel SEPARATE from the product/process and
    process/organization pathways. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.
  t2_model: Is there documented incompatibility of the two business models
    (value-capture logics that could not be reconciled over time)? A channel
    SEPARATE from the pathways above. 1 = yes; 0 = no; uncertain.

D. performance_metric: the single best-documented post-deal outcome scalar in the
   slice (e.g. "divested 80.1% after ~108 months", "~$99bn goodwill write-down",
   "no divestiture; assets retained"). One short phrase. If none, "not documented".

rationale: 2-4 sentences citing the slice lines that drove your p4_pathway and
p5_pathway codes specifically. Cite ONLY realized-outcome evidence; do NOT reason
about how the deal was structured at closing.

Emit ONLY the structured record. Code conservatively: absence of documented
evidence for a pathway is 0 (not-documented); inability to determine is "uncertain".

# Outcome sub-dossier — GT Advanced Technologies Inc. realized record, fixed ~3-5-year window (~2017-2019)

> EVIDENTIARY STANDARD: every factual line ends with a `[SRC: <SEC accession / URL>]`
> tag pointing to a public primary source. A fact that cannot be so sourced is written
> `[UNVERIFIED]` and is never guessed. This sub-dossier describes ONLY the realized
> record after the closing-era event. It contains no information about how the
> transaction was structured. The outcome window is fixed at approximately 2017-2019
> (three-to-five years after the ~2014 closing-era event).

## Public-reporting status heading into the outcome window (feasibility-relevant)
- The registrant's last annual report (Form 10-K) on EDGAR was filed March 11, 2014
  (covering fiscal year 2013); no Form 10-K or Form 10-Q was filed by the registrant after
  2014. [SRC: SEC accession 0001047469-14-002123, Form 10-K]
- A Form 25-NSE (notification of removal from listing/registration) was filed on the
  registrant's securities on December 11, 2014. [SRC: SEC accession 0001354457-14-000212, Form 25-NSE]

## Realized disposition of the reorganization (traced through the emergence filings)
- On March 8, 2016 the Bankruptcy Court entered an order confirming the Debtors' Amended
  Joint Plan of Reorganization under Chapter 11 (dated March 7, 2016). [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-16-012680, Form 8-K Item 1.03]
- Under the Plan, all outstanding equity interests of the company, including all outstanding
  shares of common stock (137,662,024 shares of $0.01 par value common stock as of the
  filing date), options, and rights to acquire equity, were to be cancelled and
  extinguished on the Effective Date; holders of existing common stock and of Class 5
  Subordinated Securities Claims were to receive no distribution on account of those
  interests or claims. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-16-012680, Form 8-K Item 1.03]
- The reorganized capital structure was to consist of $60 million of Senior Secured Notes,
  Preferred Stock representing 86% of the reorganized common ownership on an as-converted
  basis (issued to the Financing Support Parties for $20 million), and Reorganized Common
  Stock, with holders of allowed general unsecured claims receiving Reorganized Common
  Stock representing 14% of the equity. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-16-012680, Form 8-K Item 1.03]
- The Plan provided for a Litigation Trust to hold specified claims and D&O causes of
  action for the benefit of certain unsecured claimants; the existing board of directors
  was deemed to have resigned on the Effective Date and a newly appointed board was to take
  office. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-16-012680, Form 8-K Item 1.03]
- The company stated it intended to file a Form 15 to suspend its Exchange Act reporting
  obligations as soon after the Effective Date as possible. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-16-012680, Form 8-K Item 1.03]
- On March 21, 2016 the company filed a Form 15 (15-15D) terminating/suspending its duty to
  file reports; it reported 61 holders of record of common stock as of the notice date. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-16-012832, Form 15-15D]

## Realized record within the fixed outcome window (~2017-2019)
- Because the company suspended its Exchange Act reporting obligations in March 2016, no
  annual, quarterly, or other periodic SEC report exists for the fixed ~2017-2019 outcome
  window; no audited public financial statement or financial scalar is available for that
  window. The outcome within the fixed window is therefore coded UNCERTAIN on the public
  record; it is not inferred or fabricated. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-16-012832, Form 15-15D]
- No primary-sourced facts documenting post-emergence disruption at the product/operations
  interface or at the operations/management interface within the fixed window are available
  from the public SEC record. [UNVERIFIED]

## Outcome summary (realized record only)
- The single best-documented realized outcome scalar is the complete extinguishment of the
  pre-existing equity: 137,662,024 shares of common stock were cancelled and holders of
  common stock received no distribution under the confirmed plan of reorganization. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-16-012680, Form 8-K Item 1.03]
- The realized disposition was that the pre-existing public company's equity was wiped out,
  control of the reorganized entity passed to the financing support parties and general
  unsecured claimants, and the reorganized entity ceased public reporting in March 2016; for
  the fixed ~2017-2019 window there is consequently no public audited record, and the
  outcome within that window is coded uncertain. [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-16-012680, Form 8-K Item 1.03] [SRC: SEC accession 0001628280-16-012832, Form 15-15D]
</content>

[SLICE END]
